studio.character.poseV3.title: Pose · Joints and Foot Lock
studio.character.poseV3.description: Corrects only the selected parts on the actual rig. Preserves joint limits and limb lengths; save after preview.
studio.character.poseV3.footPlantHelp: Foot lock keeps the current ankle contact. It does not auto-estimate the model's sole shape. Unlock to move the foot.
studio.character.poseV3.limits: Available on normalized VRM humanoid models. Use the existing hand shape editor for fingers; unreachable targets report the remaining error.
studio.character.groom.description: New guides are edited in head-bone local coordinates (m). Imported scalp root anchors follow the verified source surface and skin. Applying the preview saves the source guides and curve settings.
studio.character.groom.unsupported: Hair can be edited on VRM models with an actual head bone.
studio.character.groom.otherPreview: Apply or cancel another tool's preview before editing.
studio.character.groom.empty: Add a group to get started
studio.character.groom.name: Group name
studio.character.groom.locked: Locked group. Cannot edit to protect the source.
studio.character.groom.anchorAttached: Scalp root anchor attached to the source surface. Follows pose·expression deformation; length·width·visibility are editable. Anchor repositioning and auto reprojection are not supported.
studio.character.groom.anchorPending: Not shown as mesh until the imported scalp surface and root anchors are verified. Other topologies, multi-point anchors, and separate primitives preserve the source.
studio.character.groom.previewing: Previewing · source is kept until applied.
studio.character.groom.draft: Editing · check the actual shape in the hair preview.
studio.character.groom.saved: Applied source guides are included in character save·export.
studio.character.groom.skipped: Could not verify the guide's surface or topology, so mesh display is on hold. The source is preserved.
studio.character.workspace.fileError: Could not read the file. Please select it again.
studio.character.pose.selectionHelp: Edits only the selected bones, applying foot lock and joint limits to the actual rig.
studio.character.authoring.preservedUnsu: The source is saved but cannot be shown on the current compatible model view.
studio.character.authoring.extrasBuildin: Applying materials and contour lines to the screen.
studio.character.authoring.applying: Applying the authoring document to the character.
studio.character.categories.title: Edit categories
studio.character.library.title: Character library
studio.character.library.empty: Import your VRM file to add a character.
studio.character.library.localHint: Continue with your models and saved characters.
studio.character.paint.cameraLocked: Rotation locked · drag on the model surface to draw.
studio.character.reference.editManually: Close reference tool and edit manually
studio.character.reference.photoRecovery: If the photo can't be read, pick a JPG·PNG·WebP file again in 'Choose photo'. A clear full-body shot with visible limbs works best.
studio.character.reference.webcamEngineR: Could not prepare the tracking model. Check the connection and retry, or use photo pose.
studio.character.reference.webcamCameraR: Check camera permission in the browser's site settings, close other apps using the camera, then retry. Photo pose works without a camera.
studio.character.shelf.interactionHint: Card shape diagrams differ from actual model images. Touch applies on tap and does not change on scroll. Hover or keyboard-select to preview in 3D; save·undo history is unchanged before clicking. Favorites are stored in this browser only.
